claim_text: We work hard to safely manage tailings, reduce waste, and rehabilitate land disturbed by our activities.

notes: 复合式主张中只有部分要素有量化证据。
llm_reason: The claim asserts that the company works hard to safely manage tailings, reduce waste, and rehabilitate land. The provided evidence fields are empty, so there is no substantive evidence to support any part of the claim. Without any factual grounding, the claim is unsubstantiated.
